citations.quote:
[name="帕蒂亚"]真的没完没了……
[name="帕蒂亚"]继续战斗的话，我就只能用手里的武器去砸了！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1795_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="离群萨科塔"]我也是。
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_spelldfns_2", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.1, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.7, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]我的手快酸得抬不起来了。
[name="莫斯提马"]菲亚梅塔那家伙不知道怎么样了。按照计划，等她装好炸药，我们就炸毁地块的锁定装置，把整个圣马尔索区推出去。
[name="莫斯提马"]也把那些怪物彻底隔绝在大教堂之外。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_snarl_1", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]啧，如果我们能守到那时候的话。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[MusicVolume(volume=0.2, fadetime=1)]
[name="？？？"]散逸箭！
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="all")]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrow_rain", volume=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1.5, xstrength=28, ystrength=20, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown1", volume=1)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[name="？？？"]他们就暂时先交给我好了！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]这身装扮……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[MusicVolume(volume=0.6, fadetime=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#6",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#6",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]兰登卫队，单人临时战斗编队，席德佳，前来支援！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#11$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]兰登……抱歉，没什么印象。
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#2",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]没关系，习惯了，哈哈。
[name="席德佳"]我有几个萨科塔同事在那支队伍里。她们和我一样，在跑商务的途中被召回来，然后就……经历了那一切。
[name="席德佳"]怎么说呢，虽然这段时间的事情都是假的，兰登修道院其实根本就没得到教皇厅的重用……
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#1",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]但只要有我在，拉特兰就会重新记住“兰登修道院”这个名字的！
[name="席德佳"]总之，那些怪物虽然看起来诡异，但总不至于比大雪封山后的野兽更难缠。
[name="席德佳"]我带了足够的箭，射得也很准。我可以帮你们先抵挡一阵子！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1795_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="离群萨科塔"]但我们已经累了，小姑娘。办法想了，力气费了，结果还是一退再退。
[name="离群萨科塔"]这哪还称得上什么清算，什么了结，我看这是我们又来拉特兰受罪了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1806_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="堕天使"]莫斯提马，约定的时间马上就到了，那个叫蕾缪安的依然没消息？
[name="堕天使"]如果没能解除那些地块锁定装置的防护，我们恐怕连它们的护甲都炸不穿，对吧？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1795_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="离群萨科塔"]照我说，就到此为止吧。
[name="离群萨科塔"]就算那支队伍真的进了大教堂，又会怎么样呢？所有人都变成差不多的萨科塔？
[name="离群萨科塔"]说真的，那和我们这些异类有什么关系呢？
[name="离群萨科塔"]你看看周围这几十个人，凑得出一顶完整的光环吗？好不容易赶过来支援的，还是个黎博利修女。
[name="离群萨科塔"]整座城市的人都在对面，为什么是我们这些异类在阻止这一切？
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#4",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]唔，不对，不能这么想……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]因为现在只有我们能做到。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="n")]
[name="离群萨科塔们"]……
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]我们这些异类，不是一直在努力去做那些对正常萨科塔而言理所当然的事吗？

[name="菲亚梅塔"]忘记了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]你那边怎么样？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#9$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]好消息，炸弹已经就位。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[multiline(name="菲亚梅塔")]坏消息，我怕它们的威力不足以摧毁全部的锁定装置，把剩下的榴弹也都安上去了……
[name="菲亚梅塔"]所以，我现在已经没有任何弹药去对付这些怪物了。
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_snarl_1", volume=0.6)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="蒙恩的生物A"]（光环急速闪烁）
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="蒙恩的生物B"]（连续不断的祷告声）
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_213_mostma_1#8$1",focus="m")]
[name="莫斯提马"]喂，菲亚梅塔，启动吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]等等，蕾缪安那边还没有消息，如果锁定装置没能及时解除防护，我们所有的炸药就都浪费了……
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="h")]
[StopSound(channel="h", fadetime=6)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_300_phenxi_1#7$1",focus="m")]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]爆破倒计时，一分钟！
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_357_1#10$1",focus="m")]
[name="帕蒂亚"]你？
[Dialog]
[charslot]
计时器的声音从菲亚梅塔的手中传出，蒙恩的生物纷纷停下了祷告，他们像是预感到了会发生什么，发疯了似的向她扑了过来。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_monsterroar", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=0.5)]
[Delay(time=0.7)]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_wolflordclaw",volume=0.7)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.05, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=255, g=255, b=255, fadetime=0.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=0.2)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowshot")]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_arrowtarget", volume=0.6,delay=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$bodyfalldown2", volume=1,delay=0.8)]
[Delay(time=0.5)]
[charslot(duration=0.7)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_sandnmlfts", volume=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_1792_1#1$1",duration=1)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="char_332_archet#6",focus="m")]
[name="席德佳"]……
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[Background(image="bg_black",screenadapt="coverall")]
[delay(time=0.5)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
席德佳摸向箭壶，里面已经空了。
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs")]
[StopSound(channel="fs", fadetime=4.5)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[stopmusic(fadetime=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，五十秒！
[name="？？？"]抱歉，各位，希望我没有来迟！
[Dialog]
[playsound(key="$d_avg_electrcwhlchrrll",volume=1)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=1, block=true)]
[charslot]
[image(image="61_i19",screenadapt="coverall",fadetime=0)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[CameraShake(duration=1, xstrength=30, ystrength=30, vibrato=30, randomness=90, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[PlaySound(key="$drift", volume=0.5)]
[PlayMusic(intro="$m_bat_act26side_intro", key="$m_bat_act26side_loop", volume=0.6)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2.5, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
车轮急刹，在地面激荡起烟尘。车手拧转轮椅，右手在同一时间举起了铳，她的长发在空中肆意飞舞。
[name="莫斯提马"]时间刚刚好！
[name="蕾缪安"]菲亚梅塔，莫斯提马，我们的配合还是那么默契！
[name="蕾缪安"]哈哈，你俩肯定猜不到，从第七厅一路突围到这里，我把自己轮椅竞速射击赛的纪录突破了多少！
[Dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_heartratemonitor", volume=0.8, loop=true, channel="fs1")]
[StopSound(channel="fs1", fadetime=3)]
[Delay(time=1.5)]
[name="菲亚梅塔"]倒计时，四十秒！
